verdict.rationale: First-party docs say AI reviews suggest fixes. In Graphite Chat you can request a suggested fix and apply it in one click from the review page, and diagnose and resolve failing CI checks from the PR page. The PR-page Agent can make direct code changes or generate changes as a draft PR, which covers both the committed-patch and agent-follow-up paths without leaving the PR. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that one-click apply works in practice, and explicit documentation of how an applied fix is committed or pushed to the PR branch.
